creativity.reason: Level 1: this rests on general language only. The bank's business shows no material creative activity, and design thinking appears only as a routine input to front-end applications.

community.reason: Level 4: there is a very large, measured external community and education commitment central to strategy, including DBS Foundation programmes benefitting more than one million individuals, 320,000 students in Smart Buddy and 300,000 volunteer hours.

cross_cultural.reason: Level 3: named customer-access programmes for migrant workers, people with special needs and low-income customers have measured reach, such as over 900,000 migrant worker accounts and 9,000 workshop participants, but they are not shown as a major business line.

entrepreneurship.reason: Level 3: named enabling programmes report numbers of businesses helped, including 26 Businesses for Impact and the SGD 3 million Impact Beyond Award to four winners, beyond ordinary SME lending.

ai.notes: Ordinary SME lending (over SGD 500 million unsecured MSME loans) and SME customer metrics were treated as 'serving' and did not raise the Entrepreneurship score. A card game produced under the DBS Foundation and SUSS partnership is a cognitive-health tool, not a creative business, so it did not lift Creativity. The Chairman's arts-college directorships are personal commitments, not company activity. The co-branded Garena gaming card is a marketing product. The Board requested a Special Review of DBS Foundation, but no findings are disclosed. Much detail is referred to a separate Sustainability Report, but the annual report itself contains enough specific activities for sufficient coverage on all themes.
